revision.reason: Reconciled to committed Notifications implementation after user-requested rename, inline unread dots, and safe-area correction.

architecture.framework: Expo SDK 57, React Native, TypeScript, Expo Router typed routes
architecture.navigation: Exactly five existing NativeTabs triggers. Home tabName is (home), hosting the nested home Stack. Public URLs remain / and /alerts.
architecture.integrationBoundary: Keep the nested route adapters thin and render Notifications. The (home) Stack owns HomeDashboard and Notifications while AppTabs owns the shared bottom navigation.
architecture.screenOwnerBoundary: Notification content and local read/filter state live in src/screens/notifications/index.tsx. Bottom navigation is owned by AppTabs.

layout.parentOwner: src/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx delegates to AppTabs; src/app/(tabs)/(home)/_layout.tsx is a nested Stack inside the home NativeTabs route.
layout.safeArea: Notifications uses SafeAreaView edges=['top']. Its ScrollView reserves BottomTabInset + useSafeAreaInsets().bottom + Spacing.four so the final card clears the floating native tab bar.
layout.scrolling: Vertical ScrollView with explicit bottom content padding; horizontal ScrollView for category chips.
layout.tabs: Use exactly the existing five shared tab items. Do not add an alerts registry item or NativeTabs.Trigger; /alerts is a sibling screen in the home Stack and the home tab remains selected.

patterns.primitives: Reuse ThemedText, ThemedView, Pressable, ScrollView, SafeAreaView, and StyleSheet already used by the owner and neighboring screens.
patterns.theme: useTheme reads semantic Colors; Spacing, Radius, Fonts, BottomTabInset, and MaxContentWidth are in src/constants/theme.ts.
patterns.typography: ThemedText supports the existing title/headline/body/label roles; do not add a font or token.
patterns.icons: Reuse Icon/IconName from src/screens/home-dashboard/icons.tsx, including notifications and notification_important mappings; do not edit the icon registry.
patterns.stateAndData: The current owner uses screen-local NotificationItem data and unread/filter state. No shared Notification domain type, API source, or persistence key exists; keep this bounded local pattern.
patterns.similarImplementations: src/components/app-tabs.tsx and src/components/app-tabs.web.tsx are the existing native/web navigators; src/constants/navigation.ts is their shared route registry; src/screens/home-dashboard/dashboard-header.tsx is the shared source bell.
